purpose: Repair the diagnosed instrument defect, not the outcome: the corpus's evidence_fetch_sha256 hashes an unretained GitHub REST representation and is unreproducible from git objects (V1 diagnosis, 31/31 eligible rows DIGEST_MISMATCH). This increment observes, from live git objects at each pinned sha, the license blob path (parsed from the frozen evidence_url), git blob SHA-1, blob-byte SHA-256 and byte length, and records them as NEW receipted bindings under this NEW identity. The V1 adverse terminal and the old field are never relabelled.
subjects: all 45 corpus entries at their pinned shas; gold_eligible flags carried through unchanged
observations_per_entry: pinned_object_exists (with one recorded unadvertised-object fetch retry)
license_path parsed from frozen evidence_url blob URL
blob_byte_sha256 and blob_bytes via cat-file blob
rest_hash_context: OBSERVED_EQUALS_REST_HASH | OBSERVED_DIFFERS_FROM_REST_HASH (context only, evidencing nothing beyond the V1 diagnosis)

planted_controls.control_a: forged pinned sha (one hex flipped) through the SAME observe path must not reach BINDING_RECORDED
planted_controls.control_b: forged license path through the SAME observe path must not reach BINDING_RECORDED
planted_controls.rule: either control failing to fire makes the run terminal CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE

terminal_semantics.T1_ALL_BINDINGS_RECORDED: every corpus entry now carries a git-verifiable license binding; a later campaign increment may verify license bytes against THESE bindings, while gold eligibility still requires the frozen derivation contract's preconditions
terminal_semantics.T2_PARTIAL_BINDINGS_RECORDED: entries without a recorded binding stay CANNOT_CHECK and cannot support later license verification
terminal_semantics.T3_NO_BINDING_RECORDED: the repair failed; the campaign remains blocked exactly as V1 left it
terminal_semantics.CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE: nothing observed in the run is evidence

prohibitions.v1_relabelling: the V1 adverse terminal and evidence_fetch_sha256 field are never edited or reinterpreted
prohibitions.post_outcome_edits: no subject, predicate, or terminal may change after the first observation receipt is written

execution_plan.host: billy-old, strictly after the running pilot-target acquisition V2 completes (shared clone cache, serialized runs)
execution_plan.outputs: development/p13-p14-corpus-git-license-binding-v1/receipts/CORPUS_GIT_LICENSE_BINDING_RECEIPTS_V1.json committed strictly after this design commit
